text: Six reports covered 11 Nov: Operations, HR & Admin, Accounts, IT, Flower shop and AJ1881 (Accounts and IT sent the next morning). Reception, Maintenance, Housekeeping and Drivers reports not seen, so there is no occupancy figure for 11 Nov; the last reported figure is 95 of 183 rooms on 10 Nov.

Gravity fixed the lifts on the 7th and 15th floors; their maintenance quotation is awaited. More vendors are being sourced for BMS comparison quotes. The VingCard key-card system was reported down; a technical inspection was requested.
4 complaints received and 4 closed: Wi-Fi in rooms 1401 and 501, a door in room 1110 and the reception PC. Equal software reported slow; optimisation in progress.

Payments recorded from El Sewedy Power for premium rooms 502 and 504 and for room 206; two cheques deposited. No returned cheques and no overdue rent reported. Etisalat bill awaiting payment approval. TH-202 replacement cheque not confirmed.

Room 212 renewal under review; Management asked for tenancy registration, licence and contract-term details. MBG sent a revised accounting and VAT proposal (V.02), with corporate tax quoted separately. Operations listed the new Etisalat Wi-Fi line as awaiting approval.

AJ1881 sales AED 82 from 4 covers; coffee machine still not working (missing parts). Flower shop sales AED 0, no new orders. Carpenter visited for the lobby café, kiosk and 1st-floor buffet; quotation awaited.
ADNOC HSE requirements and documents still being completed, a priority for 12 Nov. El Sewedy payment received for two premium rooms.
